email_body:
Hello Breese Pitt Dixon team,

Your careers page says you are keen to hear from graduate civil engineers and asks for an introduction with a CV, so this is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including residential subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

The work I am looking for is civil design for land development: the estate roads, drainage and retarding basins your engineers design. My software experience is from study, not commercial production, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Would you keep me in mind for a graduate civil design role, now or later?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
